description: This file defines the GatewayConnection actor and related types for managing WebSocket communication with a gateway server, including request handling, session management, and API calls for features like chat, skills, sessions, and cron jobs.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: Actor managing WebSocket connection to the gateway, providing methods for API requests, session handling, and subscription to incoming pushes.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the gateway with specified method and parameters, handling retries and fallback strategies.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Sends a raw request to the gateway with specified method, parameters, and timeout, returning raw data.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Sends a request and decodes the returned data into the specified Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Performs a request expecting no return data.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an AsyncStream of GatewayPush messages, including the latest snapshot if available.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: mainSessionKey
methods.description: Fetches or retrieves from cache the main session key, via request to the gateway.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks the health status of the gateway.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends a message or command via the agent API.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of skills.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a session.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Gets current status of cron scheduler.
